claims.scope: Exact-device RM chapter applicability; page binding is not semantic or operational closure.

contracts.detail: The XSPI, DLYB, CCB and SAES chapters each state on their first page that they apply only to the STM32C59x/C5Ax (C5A3) devices. The PKA chapter states that it applies entirely to STM32C5A3xx and partly (ECDSA signature verification only) to STM32C59xxx; STM32C542 is excluded because it is not named there, not because of an explicit negative statement. The exact STM32C53x/542 column of the RM Table 3 memory map confirms each one: XSPI1 and DLYBXS1 (p94) and CCB, PKA and SAES (p95) are all marked '- - X'. These are exclusions, not missing C542 runtime features. Generic HAL macros, residue or family registers must not instantiate them.

Ethernet is absent for the exact device in the RM master table and memory-map columns. RM p87 Table 1 lists the Ethernet MAC master as '- - X(1)' across STM32C53x/542, STM32C55x/562 and STM32C59x/5A3; the text extraction of that row is ambiguous on its own (three tokens for the columns), so the rendered page is bound as a visual check and shows '-' in the STM32C53x/542 column. RM p96 Table 3 lists the ETHERNET MAC aperture 0x4002 8000 to 0x4002 93FF as '- - X'. The exact header declares no ETH instance in its peripheral declaration block. Retain the absence despite the common-manual Ethernet chapter; do not infer a MAC/PHY, DMA owner or pin routes from chapter presence.

visual_check.finding: RM p87 Table 1 row 'Ethernet MAC' shows '-' in the STM32C53x/542 column, '-' in STM32C55x/562 and 'X(1)' in STM32C59x/5A3. Same render already pinned by memory-bus-contracts.json.

contracts.detail: Exact instantiated timers are TIM1/2/6/7/8/12/15 and LPTIM1: the header peripheral declaration block (lines 1300-1379) declares exactly those, and DS p20 Table 6 lists TIM1/TIM8, TIM2/TIM12/TIM15 and TIM6/TIM7. The exact STM32C53x/542 column of RM Table 3 excludes the others: TIM16 and TIM17 are '- X X' (p96), TIM5 is '- X X' and TIM3 and TIM4 are '- - X' (p97). TIM3/4/5/16/17 signal names in family connection tables do not instantiate them. Exclude the dedicated TIM16/17 register pages 1452-1482, but retain the shared TIM15 functional pages and filter exactly within them.

Binding every applicable RM page establishes provenance coverage only. It does not prove every field interpretation, SDK API/mode, erratum, source conflict, electrical condition or ownership constraint is complete. Full core/boot referenced manuals, exact revision, board state and engineering-lane build/hardware evidence remain separate. Shared family pages are retained and filtered per instance; whole-page inclusion does not admit family-only rows.

Two subsections inside chapters that are otherwise retained for the exact device are family-only and are filtered out: RM p103 section 3.4 Secure storage ('applies only to STM32C59xx and STM32C5Axx devices') and RM p362 section 12.5.3 SBS_NEXTHDPLCR ('applies only to STM32C59xx/C5Axx devices'). The exact header contains no NEXTHDPL symbol (full-file search at the pinned hash), which is consistent with the second filter. The page range that section 3.4 spans beyond its first page was not audited here; only the section-start statements are bound. Whole-page inclusion of p103 and p362 does not admit these subsections.
